findings.description: AWS access keys are embedded in the Lambda environment variables. Function configuration can be read by principals with Lambda configuration access, and the credentials may be exposed through source control, state, logs, or a compromised function, enabling unauthorized AWS API access.

The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime, which no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable by an attacker who can invoke or otherwise compromise the function.
